title: Saudi Lamb Noodle Stew
description: A hearty Saudi-inspired stew made with tender lamb and flavorful noodles. This comforting dish is perfect for a chilly evening.
instructions: In a large Dutch oven, heat 2 tablespoons of oil over medium-high heat.
Add the lamb and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the saudi spice blend and cook for 1 minute.
Add the noodles and cook for 2 minutes.
Add the water and bring to a boil.
Transfer the pot to the oven and simmer for 30 minutes.
Stir in the aromatic spice blend and savory powder.
Serve hot, garnished with toasted almonds and chopped fresh parsley.
